'''Galla seeds''' were found on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]]. During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]], an [[Yoda's species/Legends|alien]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] hiding on Dagobah, collected galla seeds from the area around his [[Yoda's Hut/Legends|home]].<ref name="Inside the Worlds" />

==Behind the scenes==
Galla seeds were first mentioned in the ''[[Star Wars: The Visual Dictionary]]'' written by [[David West Reynolds (real person)|David West Reynolds]] and released by [[Dorling Kindersley|DK Publishing ]] in [[1998]].<ref name="Visual Dictionary">''[[Star Wars: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>
